name: Orange Creek Inn
brand_truth: A simple, friendly inn at the quiet top of Cat Island, with a grocery downstairs and the beach across the road.

design.signature: Three-tap trip planner (Nassau or Fort Lauderdale, arrival weekday, published flights, last 3.5 miles, car/bike cost) plus a specials finder (nights + residence -> matching published Out Islands offers)

current_site_findings: One long page with #!/ links: Google sees a single page.
Headline 'Welcome to Orange Creek Inn' hides the beach-across-the-road fact.
Eight specials in a slideshow of fine print.
Flight times and costs buried at the end of 25 FAQs.
Book Now leaves the site without explanation.
pitch_line: Your guests' biggest question is how to get to Cat Island and which deal applies; this concept answers both in three taps and puts the beach across the road on the first screen.
assumptions: Western Air flies daily (FAQ says twice a day, days not listed)
Western Air lands at Arthur's Town (not stated; copy says Cat Island)
Specials terms and windows as published Nov 2026; they expire
notes: Site was refreshed in 2026 (WordPress, hoteltrafficbuilders), so the pitch is structure, findability and clarity rather than 'outdated'. Real guest reviews exist on their site (Tripadvisor/Google); not reproduced. interact.mjs marks the range slider as dead (Playwright cannot fill range inputs; it works). Fernandez Bay Village (also Cat Island) is in this repo: design deliberately different (slab type monument, casuarina green). Scorecard: 1:4 2:5 3:4 4:4 5:4 6:4 7:4 8:4 9:4 10:4 11:5.
